_comment: Template for the RSFQ test-bench tools. Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and fill in the paths for your machine. Design-derived values (clock frequency, PTL delay, core pitch, die size, I/O nets) are exported by the app to <design>.tb.json next to <design>.cir; anything set here overrides or supplements them. Run the tools from this directory (or pass --config).
_comment2: Stimulus knobs. clockPeriodPs <= 0 means derive it from freqGHz in the design config (period = 1000/freqGHz). useInputWindow uses the exporter's inputWindowTarget* bounds; startupPeriods skips extra clock edges. settlePs is the earliest absolute launch time; the earlier of clock/data starts there. inputWindowMode is start|center|end|positive (end avoids the too-early edge of the derived window). dataPhasePs is only the fallback when inputWindowFound is false. pipelineLevels is the max clock depth; outputWatchStart = clockSend + (pipelineLevels-1)*period + minOutputTravelPs. decodeWindowStartPs equals outputWatchStartPs by default; decodeStartPeriods shifts it by whole clock periods. pipelineLatencySlots is the older fallback. timeStepPs/josimMaxRows keep JoSIM's time-point memory in check (measured: 80k points OK, 100k crashed on an 8 GB box).
